g.text: TOUR · 5 / 8 · REVIEW: BOUNDED PAGES REPLACE THE BULK COLLECTOR
Four hatched patterns are new to the catalog:
Awaits rows only; streams metadata seeds
Current + at most one pending page
URL page + session start tokens only
Own summary read; failure doesn't gate
Sku / name / status / bin; one global cut
Where an item sits: shelf, bin or zone
The shared admission meter predates this
change. Callers and ownership change, not the
Scope counts are complete counts, not exact
version pins. Is that acceptable for dashboard
Shared environments must provision the sealing
key before deploy, or every page read returns
Read coherence checks do not repair the
schema: level and targetId can still disagree. Not
Card colour = pattern · line colour = who enforces a data
calls · checks with · filters through · saves · seals
